top_signals.title: US Navy, Boeing ink first MQ-25A Stingray production contract
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Navy awarded a $562 million fixed-price incentive contract to Boeing on Monday to start Lot 1 Low Rate Initial Production of the MQ-25A Stingray.

top_signals.title: Bourses and Brokers May Win From India’s Proposed Auction Revamp
top_signals.summary: Stock exchanges and brokers could be among the biggest beneficiaries of the Securities and Exchange Board of India’s proposed changes to the newly launched closing auction system that’s caused chaos, while market makers may face tighter constraints.
